text.p: ASA Kindlustus (ASA Insurance) said on Tuesday it plans to develop its local representatives network this year and is eyeing expansion to neighbouring markets next year.
"We plan to invest 2.5 million kroons in the development of our representatives," director Sergei Netsajev told a news conference. ASA already has 11 representatives in Estonia.
"Next year we will presumably enter the Latvian and Lithuanian market," he added.
Netsajev added that the insurance company was working already in the Ukrainian market as an experiment.
ASA's current year net profit was 7.2 million kroons at the end of May. Its profit estimate is 18.88 million kroons for 1997 compared to 0.97 million kroons last year.
Major shareholder Wellfix Investment Ltd last week sold 475,000 shares to Estonian investors in a closed offering.
Hansa Investments deputy director Viktor Mahhov said the closed offering is continuing during the following weeks to foreign investors in London and Scandinavia.
The public offering of 350,000 shares is to start after that and hopefully be completed in August, Mahhov said.
ASA Kindlustus will after the public issue apply for a listing on the main list of the Tallinn bourse.
ASA's share capital will be 28.9 million kroons after the issue.
